date_note: Katadata (published 26 November) reports Mekari's 25 November statements; the page says unusual activity was detected on the morning of 25 November.
geo_basis: country as the source states it (Indonesia); no city given
title: Mekari says an external party attacked its systems; Talenta payroll and other apps disrupted
summary: Katadata reports that Mekari, the company behind Talenta, Qontak, Sign, Jurnal and Flex, said in a 25 November Instagram post that unusual activity was a cyberattack from an external party. Users complained of delayed salary payments. Bloomberg Technoz reported on 26 November that Mekari said it disabled systems to prevent data movement and that some services, including Mekari Sign, were still down that morning.
plain: Mekari, an Indonesian business software firm, says an outside party attacked its systems. Users reported late salary payments, and Bloomberg Technoz reports some services were still down on 26 November.
exec: Mekari says it was hit by a cyberattack; users of Talenta reported late salary payments, per Katadata.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Mekari's CEO warns it never asks for passwords, OTP codes or payments by email, WhatsApp or phone.

validation.note: Katadata quotes Mekari's Instagram post and CEO letter; Bloomberg Technoz quotes Mekari on disabling systems but calls it a suspected cybersecurity incident, so the attack wording rests on Katadata. Mekari's own pages not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: plain/exec stated payroll delay as fact; Katadata says users reported late payments
